description:
FILED s543a (Opus, 2026-11-21), found while reading the bench rows' emission -- PERF (no output change), caused by the line-track flip, NOT fixed in s543a (the resume of 2026-11-21 fixed the batch's work list; one predicate, see FIX).

WHAT: `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp` `p-sub` marks an EMPTY `DESTROY` / `AUTOLOAD` (the AUTOLOAD-guard idiom `sub DESTROY {}`, #2371 s538b) by an exact shape match on its body:
    (equal body '((p-args-body (block nil (p-return-empty)))))
Since s543a line tracking is ON by default and every sub body heads with `(p-file "...")` (ir-spec 6.3b), so the empty sub's body is
    ((p-args-body (block nil (p-file "-") (p-return-empty))))
and the match fails: no `%p-mark-empty-destroy`, so `%p-destroy-note-install` OPENS the global-destruction gate (`*p-destroy-live*`).  The same held under `PCL_OPT=line-track` since s539d; the flip made it the default.

EFFECT (time only): while the gate is open EVERY bless registers its referent in the weak vector (+28 ns a registration, s538b's measurement in the header above `*p-destroy-reg*`), and at exit the empty sub is CALLED once per object still alive.  Output is unchanged: an empty DESTROY does nothing either way, it still suppresses AUTOLOAD (it is found first), the registry is weak (nothing is retained).  So a program whose only DESTROY / AUTOLOAD is empty pays the gate it was exempted from: a bless loop like the bench's `blessnew` (~410 ns per object) would pay ~+7 % (an estimate from the two numbers, NOT timed).

REPRODUCER (the discriminating measurement, deterministic, no timing):
    package P; sub new { bless {}, shift } sub DESTROY {}
    package main; my $o = P->new; print ref($o), "\n";
  perl: `P`.  `./pl2cl` on base c5f618f2 (default) emits `(p-args-body (block nil (p-return-empty)))` for DESTROY -- the matched literal; the s543a tree emits `(p-args-body (block nil (p-file "-") (p-return-empty)))` -- unmatched (scratch/s543a/feread/emptydes-{base,tree}.lisp line 56 in the s543a worktree).  MEASURED at run time (scratch/s543a/gate-probe.pl: load the emitted file in its own tree's core, print `pcl::*p-destroy-live*` after the program): base default NIL, s543a tree default T, s543a tree under `PCL_OPT=-line-track` NIL.  (A program that also has a NON-empty AUTOLOAD opens the gate in every build -- not a reproducer.)

WHY THE BATCH'S INSTRUMENT MISSED IT: s543a's strip comparison (the default emission with every location form stripped vs `PCL_OPT=-line-track`, 2,053 files) proves the TEXT equal, which found classic-sort's Pl/ shape match (fixed, `Pl/ClassicSort.pm`); a cl/ MACRO that matches its argument's shape runs after that text.  A grep of cl/pcl-runtime.lisp for body-shape inspection ((first body), (car body), (null (cdr body)), (equal body ...)) found two more, both unaffected: `%p-let-presize` (the statement's (p-line) sits before the p-let, whose first body form is still the p-hash-=) and `p-void-ctx`'s sole `eval {}` (the (p-line) sits outside the p-void-ctx).  Not exhaustive: a macroexpand-all comparison of the two builds was not made.

FIX (one predicate, the classic-sort rule "a pass that matches a block body's SHAPE sees through the location forms heading it"): the empty test strips the leading `(p-file ...)` / `(p-line ...)` forms of the block before comparing -- e.g. a helper `%p-empty-sub-body-p` that accepts `((p-args-body (block nil LOC... (p-return-empty))))` with LOC only p-file / p-line forms.  Guard: a Pl/t row that loads `package P; sub DESTROY {} ...` in the default build and reads `pcl::*p-destroy-live*` = NIL (inverse: T on the s543a tree).  Bars for the fixer: cl/ changed -> the full sweep, ir-conform, the gate; the bench's bless rows.


=== DONE (s543a) === (Opus, 2026-11-21) FIXED inside s543a before the merge (the reviewing session's ruling: this batch's own regression).  `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp`: p-sub's empty DESTROY / AUTOLOAD test calls ONE helper, `%p-empty-sub-body-p` (with `%p-location-form-p`), in the expansion-time eval-when block beside %p-let-presize: the body is the one form (p-args-body (block nil LOC... (p-return-empty))) with LOC only LEADING (p-file ...) / (p-line N) stores.  Nothing exported (expansion time only); the generation stays v2-15100 (no emission change).  MEASURED with a *macroexpand-hook* that notes which expansions hold the optimised form (scratch/s543a/macro-hook.lisp + macro-probe.pl in the s543a worktree; probes scratch/s543a/empty/p1..p3, perl = PCL output on every build): the empty test over five spellings (`{}`, `{ ; }`, `{ return }`, braces over two lines, `sub AUTOLOAD {}`; `{ ; }` and `{ return }` emit (p-file "-") (p-line 3) (p-return-empty)) HIT 5 on base c5f618f2, miss 5 on c69904ac, HIT 5 on the fixed tree (and under -line-track); pcl::*p-destroy-live* NIL / T / NIL.  The two other body-shape matches, measured with the same hook where a location form could arrive inside the matched form (a statement split over lines, a sub's / loop's / if's first statement, after `# line`): %p-let-presize HIT 5 miss 1 and p-void-ctx's sole eval HIT 3 miss 2, identical on base, c69904ac and the tree -- unaffected.  `grep p-return-empty` under Pl/ cl/ lib/: Parser2 9610 is the PRODUCER of the shape (an AST-empty body), the rest are emitters (and the empty ANON sub, no location form, not a p-sub); no other recogniser of the emitted empty shape.  Guard: Pl/t/destroy-exit-01.t rows 31-34 read the gate after the program (NIL for an empty DESTROY, an empty AUTOLOAD, the multi-location spellings; T for a DESTROY with a statement); inverse on the c69904ac extraction: 31 32 33 FAIL.  BARS (scratch/s543a/ in the s543a worktree, each log with its heavy.sh END line): the full sweep GATE clean, 0 new / 0 fixed, TOTAL 18,808, drops 5 (sweep-fix.log); ir-conform 335 / 0 fail / 10 known / 0 stale, ir-host-leak 31 (irconf-fix.log); the FULL gate 379 files / 12,313 rows PASS (gate-fix.log); six bench rows after the fix (bench-fix.log, tree vs base): emptysub +3.6, methinh +1.9, blessnew -5.2, blessdes -4.6 % (none holds an empty DESTROY: the fix cannot move them).  Not measured: the gain itself (no bench row has an empty DESTROY; s538b measured +28 ns a registration).  Status left as it is (the reviewing session closes it at the merge).

=== CLOSED at MAIN-READY-99 (the reviewing session, 2026-11-21): fixed inside s543a before its merge (`%p-empty-sub-body-p`; guard Pl/t/destroy-exit-01.t rows 31-34, inverse fails on c69904ac); no baseline row is keyed on it.
subject: PERF: since line tracking is on, an empty DESTROY / AUTOLOAD (sub DESTROY {}) is no longer recognised by p-sub -- its leading (p-file) hides the shape -- so it opens the global-destruction gate (+28 ns every bless); output unchanged
